name: Hu Delin
profile: Hu Delin (胡德霖, Hurun lists as 胡德林) was founder, chairman and co-controlling shareholder of Suzhou Electrical Apparatus Science Academy (EETI, SZSE 300215), a high/low-voltage electrical equipment testing firm. He died on 3 May 2023 aged 72; the company announced it on 26 June 2023.
interesting_fact: He led the 1999 restructuring of the state-run Suzhou Electrical Apparatus Research Institute into a private company and took it public on ChiNext in May 2011.
notes: Deceased (May 2023, source: Sina Finance 2023-06-26). Son Hu Chun (胡醇, Hurun co-listee) is now controlling shareholder of EETI (300215.SZ).

name: Charles Odell Schiff
current_role: Director, Cincinnati Financial Corp (CINF); EVP, secretary & treasurer, John J. & Thomas R. Schiff & Co. Inc.
profile: Charles O. 'Charlie' Schiff is a nonindependent director of Cincinnati Financial (since Aug 2020, investment committee) and an executive of John J. & Thomas R. Schiff & Co., the privately owned Cincinnati independent insurance agency bearing the names of CINF's founding-era Schiff family. His wealth reflects a large CINF stake (~1.1M+ shares).
interesting_fact: He joined the CINF board in 2020 as Thomas R. Schiff stepped down under the director age guideline; the company said he would give insight into how CINF serves its primary customer, the independent agent.
deep_cut_fact: A Fordham history graduate (magna cum laude), he has served on the boards of The Children's Theater of Cincinnati and The Cincinnati Observatory, among other local nonprofits.
notes: Low public profile; contacts are Cincinnati Financial corporate (2020 release, may have changed). Insurance industry, not energy-related.

name: Peter Dawson
profile: Most likely Peter Michael Dawson (1938-2024), executive chairman and owner of Dawsongroup, the UK truck/trailer/equipment rental group grown from his father Ted's one-lorry Leighton Buzzard haulage firm (1935). He launched Dawsonrentals in 1974. He died in 2024 after a short illness.
interesting_fact: In 1994 Commercial Motor reported he topped the Sunday Times list of richest truck-industry figures, owning 75% of Dawsongroup, then valued at £100m.
notes: Deceased (2024), source: https://dawsongroup.co.uk/peter-michael-dawson-1938-2024/ . Identity inferred from 'Transport' + UK Rich List; Dawsongroup is the only UK transport Peter Dawson with Rich List coverage found.

name: Liao Dinghai
current_role: Chairman and actual controller, Guangzhou Hi-Target Navigation Tech Co. (SZSE 300177)
profile: Liao Dinghai (b. 1963), a naval hydrographic surveyor turned entrepreneur, founded Hi-Target (中海达), a Guangzhou maker of GNSS/BeiDou surveying, mapping and marine-survey equipment that listed on ChiNext in 2011. He has chaired it since 2009 and was re-elected for a three-year term in May 2024; son Liao Wen is a director and VP.
interesting_fact: He graduated from the Dalian Naval Academy's marine surveying department and spent nearly 20 years in the PLA Navy as a unit leader and senior engineer doing marine surveying before running Hi-Target.
deep_cut_fact: Since 2015 he and Hi-Target's executives have funded a RMB10m 'Hi-Target Love Fund' (中海达爱心基金) that supports employees and their families facing serious illness or accidents.
notes: Hurun co-listee Liao Wen is his son. Relevant to podcast via BeiDou/GNSS positioning tech. Contact via board secretary office.

name: Dou Qiling
current_role: Chairwoman and controlling shareholder, Guizhou Yibai Pharmaceutical Co. (SSE 600594)
profile: Dou Qiling (窦啟玲, b. 1960), a co-founder of Guizhou Yibai Pharmaceutical in Guiyang, has led the company as chair, vice-chair and general manager over the years; it makes traditional-Chinese-medicine and oncology drugs (e.g. Aidi injection). Her daughter Dou Yaqi is now vice-chair and general manager.
interesting_fact: She holds a doctorate in business administration and is one of the few women founder-chairs of a listed Chinese drugmaker; the family runs Yibai as a two-generation team.
notes: Pharma, not energy. Company has had several regulatory warnings (2019, 2024) - avoid in outreach. Contact via board secretary email.

name: Ethan PhD Shen
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, YD Bio Limited (Nasdaq: YDES)
profile: Dr. Ethan Shen founded YD Bio (YD Biopharma) in Taiwan in 2013 as a clinical-trial drug supplier and grew it into a diversified biotech spanning DNA-methylation cancer testing, ophthalmic products (Exovisse) and stem-cell/exosome therapies. It listed on Nasdaq in Aug 2025 via a SPAC merger with Breeze Holdings; his wealth is his YDES stake.
interesting_fact: YD Bio has built a U.S. base in Washington State and partner EG BioMed's 47-state network, positioning itself as a Taiwan-US bridge for biotech commercialization.
notes: Paper wealth from a recently de-SPACed small-cap (Aug 2025, Breeze Holdings); valuation volatile. Biotech, not energy. No public detail found on his education/pre-2013 career.

name: Chen Jingna
current_role: Substantial shareholder (spousal/deemed interest), Comba Telecom Systems Holdings (HKEX 2342); no executive role found
profile: Chen Jingna (陳靜娜) is the wife of Fok Tung Ling (Huo Dongling), co-founder and chairman of Comba Telecom, a Guangzhou/Hong Kong maker of wireless base-station antennas, RF and mobile-network infrastructure. Under the SFO she is deemed interested in his Comba shares, which is the basis of her Hurun listing.
interesting_fact: Comba Telecom's annual report lists her as a substantial shareholder solely through spousal interest in Fok Tung Ling's holding (via Prime Choice Investments).
notes: Very private; no public role or interviews found. Better podcast target is husband Fok Tung Ling (Comba chairman); route via Comba IR. Alive status not confirmed (still listed in 2020 annual report).

name: Robert Nelsen
current_role: Co-founder and Managing Director, ARCH Venture Partners; director of Prime Medicine, Kardigan and other ARCH companies
profile: Bob Nelsen co-founded ARCH Venture Partners (spun out of the University of Chicago's ARCH Development) and became one of biotech's most prolific company builders, seeding Illumina, Alnylam, Juno, GRAIL, Sana, Lyell and many more. ARCH closed Fund XIII (>bn); he sits on numerous boards and holds large stakes in Prime Medicine, Lyell, Neumora and others.
interesting_fact: His seed and early-stage investments include Illumina, Alnylam, Juno, Agios, Denali, Beam and bluebird bio - over 100 companies, more than 20 of which became bn+ companies.
deep_cut_fact: Not only biotech: his early bets listed alongside Illumina include Classmates.com and Everyday Learning Corporation. He holds a B.S. in economics and biology from the University of Puget Sound and a Chicago Booth MBA.

public_contacts.value: FGS Global (Morgan Warners), morgan.warners@fgsglobal.com - listed as ARCH media contact on press releases (reported via search; verify)

notes: High-profile VC, known to be outspoken (e.g. on biotech/AI) - plausible podcast guest. Best route via ARCH/FGS Global. archventure.com blocks automated fetches; media contact not directly verified.

name: Mao Liping
current_role: Co-founding shareholder (and director from 2019) of Eyebright Medical (爱博医疗, SSE STAR 688050); chairman of 弘浩明传科技(北京)
profile: Mao Liping (b. 1966) co-funded Eyebright Medical in 2010 with founder Xie Jiangbing, putting in RMB9.8m alongside wife Bai Ying; the Beijing firm makes intraocular lenses and orthokeratology lenses and listed on the STAR Market in 2020. The couple held ~5.85% in 2026 and have been trimming the stake.
interesting_fact: Before backing an ophthalmic-device maker he was a telecoms executive - marketing director and VP at Shenzhen Guoren Communications - after starting out in HR at the Ministry of Electronics' components company.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a law (economic law) bachelor's from Renmin University of China and an MBA from Peking University's Guanghua School of Management.
notes: Investor rather than operator; low profile. Current Eyebright board status after 2025 re-election not verified. IR email from 2019 prospectus. Web search budget ran out during this lane.

name: Song Jilong
current_role: Chairman, Ningbo Donly Co. (宁波东力, SZSE 002164); also heads Donly Holding Group
profile: Song Jilong (宋济隆) has chaired Ningbo Donly since January 2006. Donly was the first Chinese gear-industry company listed on the A-share market and makes industrial gear reducers, motors, automation systems and automatic door systems for metallurgy, mining, hydropower, ports and logistics.
interesting_fact: Donly's product range spans from a 176-tonne hot-rolling-mill vertical-roll gearbox and 2,500kW permanent-magnet high-voltage motors down to 100-gram harmonic reducers for robotics.
deep_cut_fact: Its subsidiary Donly Transmission is a national 'single-item manufacturing champion' and runs a national post-doctoral research station; Song holds a master's degree and is a senior economist.
notes: Industrial drivetrains for heavy industry/hydropower - loosely energy-adjacent. Low media profile; route via board secretary (zq@donly.com).

name: Qu Honggui
current_role: Chairman, Anhui Zhongdian Xinlong Technology Co. (formerly Sinonet / 中电兴发, SZSE 002298)
profile: Qu Honggui (瞿洪桂, b. 1965), a UESTC-trained engineer and former manager at the Ministry of Electronics' China Electronic Equipment Corp., built Sinonet (北京中电兴发) in smart-city/public-security systems and chairs the listed parent. The group now focuses on smart power distribution equipment and new energy: energy storage, solar plants, EV chargers and carbon-management software.
interesting_fact: The company's pivot puts it squarely in the energy transition: switchgear and power distribution plus new-type energy storage systems, PV and charging infrastructure.
deep_cut_fact: He co-founded a counter-terrorism/police equipment joint lab with his alma mater, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, where he is a research fellow; he was named a 2019 'Smart City Leader' and one of Anhui's '30 Best Innovative Entrepreneurs'.
notes: Strong fit for an energy/data-center podcast (power distribution + storage). Contact email is the board secretary address published in the 2025 annual report.

name: Xie Qingkui
current_role: Chairman, Guilin Seamild Foods Co. (西麦食品, SZSE 002956)
profile: Xie Qingkui (谢庆奎, b. 1951) is the founder-chairman of Seamild, a Guilin-based maker of oat cereals and healthy-grain foods that he previously also ran as general manager. Seamild, listed in 2019, describes itself as a pioneer and leader of China's oat industry with a field-to-table supply chain.
interesting_fact: Seamild runs oat production lines imported from Switzerland's Bühler Group and has a grain subsidiary in Zhangbei, Hebei, as part of its farm-to-table oat chain.
notes: Consumer food, not energy. Born 1951; low media profile. Route via board secretary office.

name: Sun Zhen
current_role: Founder, Chairman and General Manager, Beijing Yuanlong Yato Culture Dissemination Co. (元隆雅图, SZSE 002878)
profile: Sun Zhen (孙震, b. 1964) left university teaching to found Yuanlong Yato in 1998. The Beijing company provides integrated marketing (corporate gifts, digital/new-media and Web3 marketing) and IP cultural products, notably official licensed merchandise for major sporting events.
interesting_fact: Yuanlong Yato has been an official licensed producer/retailer for the 2008 Beijing Olympics, 2010 Shanghai Expo, 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics, and the 2025 Harbin Asian Winter Games.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding the company he was a teacher at Beijing Union University's economics & management school (1988-90) and a lecturer at Beijing University of Technology (1990-98); he chairs the gift-industry chamber of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce.
notes: Marketing/merch business, not energy; entrepreneurship angle (professor-turned-founder). Route via company email.

name: Fu Lin
current_role: Director and Deputy General Manager, Zhuhai Bojay Electronics Co. (博杰股份, SZSE 002975)
profile: Fu Lin (付林, b. 1971), an electronics test engineer, is a long-time executive and shareholder of Zhuhai Bojay, where he was executive director and sales director from 2005 before becoming deputy GM (2018) and director (2023). Bojay makes automated test and assembly equipment and supplies electrical-test systems for AI/data-center servers.
interesting_fact: Bojay says it supplies server test equipment to Nvidia, Dell, Amazon, Microsoft and Cisco plus Inspur, Alibaba and Tencent, and has built factories in Mexico, Vietnam and the US.
deep_cut_fact: He started his career in 1997 as a product test engineer at TCL-Thomson Electronics in Shenzhen, then worked as a test engineer at a Dongguan electronics factory before joining Bojay.
notes: Good data-center angle (AI server test equipment). Not the chairman (chairman is Wang Zhaochun); Fu is a co-founder/executive. Route via securities dept email.

name: Zeng Shaoqiang
current_role: Vice Chairman, Hybio Pharmaceutical (翰宇药业, SZSE 300199); Chairman, Hybio Holdings
profile: Zeng Shaoqiang (曾少强, b. 1971) co-built Shenzhen-based Hybio Pharmaceutical, a peptide-drug specialist covering APIs through finished formulations (including GLP-1 peptide products), alongside chairman Zeng Shaogui. He is vice chairman and also chairs Hybio Holdings.
interesting_fact: Hybio has built a full peptide-drug chain from API to formulation and works on GLP-1 analogues, oncology peptides and peptide vaccines.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a global management doctorate from a Tsinghua SEM/University of Minnesota programme, a Tsinghua MBA and a CKGSB EMBA, and serves as chairman of the Bao'an District Federation of Industry and Commerce in Shenzhen.
notes: Pharma, not energy. Politically connected (former Guangdong CPPCC standing committee member, Shenzhen People's Congress deputy).

name: Qian Juhua
current_role: Shareholder (~6.07%) of Xingguang Agricultural Machinery (星光农机, SSE 603789); no executive role found
profile: Qian Juhua (钱菊花) is a founding-family shareholder of Xingguang Agricultural Machinery, the Huzhou, Zhejiang maker of combine harvesters and farm machinery founded/led by Zhang Shenqiang, with whom she is a registered party acting in concert. Control of the company has since passed to Xingguang Agri-Tech Holding (backed by CRRC-linked investors).
interesting_fact: She still held 16.4m shares (6.07%) at end-2025 and is listed with Zhang Shenqiang and Xinjiayuan as concert parties, while Zhang irrevocably waived voting rights on his 18.88% to the new controller.
notes: Very private passive shareholder; no public profile or interviews found. Company is now under *ST risk warning - avoid in outreach. Hurun co-listee Zhang Shengqiang = Zhang Shenqiang (章沈强).

name: Huang Peijin
current_role: Founder and former chairman/controller of Hainan Shennong Dafeng Seed (now 神农种业, SZSE 300189); current role not found
profile: Huang Peijin (黄培劲, b. 1963), a hybrid-rice seed-production expert and former Hunan seed-company executive, founded Hainan Shennong Dafeng (Grand Agriseeds) in 2000, contributing his hybrid-rice seed-production patent as capital, and took it public on ChiNext in 2011. He no longer appears among the company's directors or major shareholders.
interesting_fact: His 1992 invention, a method for ultra-high-yield hybrid rice seed production, won a WIPO Outstanding Young Inventor gold medal - the only WIPO top award in hybrid rice besides Yuan Longping's.
deep_cut_fact: He won the first-ever Yuan Longping Agricultural Science & Technology Award in 1998, proposed a Seed Law bill to the National People's Congress, and made a TV teaching series on high-yield hybrid seed production.

public_contacts.value: sndf2010@126.com (company board office; he is no longer involved)

notes: Appears to have exited Shennong (company now controlled by others); no current contact route found. Web search budget exhausted, so current status/whereabouts not checked.

name: Lai Ganfeng
current_role: Controller of Guangdong Hengrun Huachuang Industrial Development; actual controller of Hunan Tianrun Digital Entertainment (*ST天润, SZSE 002113) as of 2023
profile: Lai Ganfeng (赖淦锋) is a Guangdong investor who controls the Hengrun group (广东恒润华创实业发展, 广东恒润互兴资产管理), through which he became actual controller of Hunan-listed Tianrun (game/digital entertainment). Hurun listed his wealth under 'Eforce' (video display, investment) with Mai Xiujin.
interesting_fact: In mid-2016 he bought ~3.85m more Tianrun shares through an asset-management plan, citing confidence in the company, when he and his Hengrun entities held ~27% combined.
notes: Match between Hurun's 'Eforce' label and the Hengrun/Tianrun holdings is inferred, not confirmed. Tianrun has been under *ST with fund-occupation/guarantee and restructuring issues (2023) - avoid. Very low public profile; no appropriate contact found.

notes: Ambiguous identity; kept minimal. Lane's web-search budget was exhausted before this entry, and exchange-filing searches found no match - worth a fresh search for 'Omex Group 吴扬 water treatment'.

profile: Hurun China (2014-2015) listed Xie Haiyu (谢海榆) under 'Isea', real estate. Exchange filings name a Xie Haiyu alongside Guangdong Lihai Group (广东利海集团), a Guangzhou property developer, in a 2013 loan agreement, suggesting he is linked to Lihai; the 'Isea' link is unconfirmed.
notes: Identity only partly established (possible Lihai Group link, via Yuexiu Financial 2016 annual report, http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2017-03-23/1203186579.PDF, which concerns a loan dispute - do not use in outreach). Web-search budget exhausted; needs a fresh check.
